text.description_html:
Acorn IHWBP, Iron Art 36 Inch Dummy Whale Tail Strap Hinges For Interior And Exterior Doors

The 36 Inch Whale Tail Tip Dummy Strap Hinge will give an old world charm to any home door without the need of installing working hinges. This makes strap hinges like this one especially good for use on places where installing working hinges to get the same look would be impractical, such as on a garage door. The Iron Art 36 Inch Dummy Whale Tail Strap Hinge is for use with butt hinges. Made from hand forged iron art using the techniques of the traditional forge, it has a lifetime finish warranty.

When combined with our other great Hand Forged Iron Products, Acorn can really make your home stand out.

Specifications of the Whale Tail Tip Dummy Strap Hinges:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Length: 36"
  • Width: 3"
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Packaged with black finish mounting wood screws.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Sold Individually
